health.method: H = 100*(1 - min(1, 0.5*|b|/tau + 0.3*f30 + 0.2*max(0, sigma_r/sigma_ref - 1))) per station-variable, as of the sensor's last observation; b = EWMA (lambda 0.0588 per 3-h step) of the T3 neighbour residual; tau = 0.5 C / 5 % RH / 0.5 hPa; f30 = share of observed steps with P(fault) >= 0.5 in the last 30 days; sigma_r = residual std over the last 30 days; sigma_ref = healthy-period residual std. P(fault) is out-of-fold; the stream contains injected faults.
